motive: ∀ boundary : Fin (count + 1), SourceEqualityConstraintMemoAllocation.Valid (operations boundary) ∧ SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (heaps 0) (heaps boundary) ∧ ∀ earlier : Fin count, earlier.val < boundary.val → SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (actualBuilt earlier).2 (heaps boundary)
base_target: SourceEqualityConstraintMemoAllocation.Valid (operations 0) ∧ SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (heaps 0) (heaps 0) ∧ ∀ earlier : Fin count, earlier.val < (0 : Fin (count + 1)).val → SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (actualBuilt earlier).2 (heaps 0)
IH_full_type: SourceEqualityConstraintMemoAllocation.Valid (operations index.castSucc) ∧ SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (heaps 0) (heaps index.castSucc) ∧ ∀ earlier : Fin count, earlier.val < index.castSucc.val → SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (actualBuilt earlier).2 (heaps index.castSucc)
step_target: SourceEqualityConstraintMemoAllocation.Valid (operations index.succ) ∧ SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (heaps 0) (heaps index.succ) ∧ ∀ earlier : Fin count, earlier.val < index.succ.val → SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps (actualBuilt earlier).2 (heaps index.succ)
generalized_parameters: All request and endpoint families remain fixed. The motive varies the exact boundary. No stronger all-index IH is available.
IH_uses: ih.1 supplies actual operation Valid for this step
ih.2.2 earlier earlierLess is used ONLY when earlier ≠ index and processed establishes earlier<index
decrease: Fin.induction supplies castSucc boundary IH for exactly the next succ boundary. No theorem recursion or arbitrary boundary IH call.
finite_endpoint: Fin.last count : Fin (count+1); index.isLt is the actual strict bound for any index : Fin count. Count0 has only base and no selected row.
